Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Requesting cohort credit activation and onboarding checklist

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — SeedFoundry is excited to move our Summer 2026 cohort onto Redwood for model prototyping. We have two asks to get started:

1) Confirmation of the accelerator credit bucket we discussed (startup promotional credits + onboarding bonus).
2) Any onboarding checklist and a short MOU so our legal team can sign off quickly.

We plan to enroll 9 teams (10 people total including mentors). Typical usage will be lightweight dev + a couple of heavy tuning runs during final week. Can you confirm whether the credits can be applied across multiple project folders and whether we need a dedicated workspace?

Attaching a draft cohort roster and the accelerator one‑pager.

Thanks,
Elaine Park
Founder, SeedFoundry Labs
elaine@seedfoundry.co

Attachment: seedfoundry-accelerator-onepager.pdf (pdf)

Cc: marissa.cole@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Requesting cohort credit activation and onboarding checklist

Hi Elaine — great to hear and congrats on the cohort. Short answers up front:

- We can provision a promotional credit allocation for the cohort and allow credits to be shared across multiple projects within a single Redwood account.
- A dedicated workspace (team folder) is recommended for access control and easier cost tracking; not strictly required.
- I can push a draft MOU to you today for legal review.

Next steps I need from you:
- Confirm the company billing/legal name to include on the MOU.
- Confirm the primary contact for invoicing (if an invoice is needed for ordering a reserved bucket).
- Any compliance requirements (SOC2, IP handling) we should include in the MOU.

I’ve looped in Marissa (programs) to confirm the promotional credit amount and Karthik (commercial) for any billing/commit questions. Expect an MOU draft and an onboarding checklist from me by EOD tomorrow.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Partnerships Manager | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.com

Subject: Re: SeedFoundry cohort: credit activation & onboarding checklist

Thanks Jasmine — reviewed the request and the cohort size. Proposal: approve a one‑time promotional allocation of 75,000 trial credits (token units) plus a 5,000 onboarding bonus for the program admin. Conditions:

- Credits valid for 6 months from activation date.
- Credits are applied at the account level and can be segmented into projects by the account admin.
- For any usage expected above a sustained 20k tokens/day we should discuss a short term Dedicated burst or quota to avoid throttling; offer to set an alert.

I approve this allocation pending: 1) MOU signed by SeedFoundry legal; 2) confirmation of legal/billing entity; 3) SeedFoundry acknowledges the 6‑month expiry in writing.

Marissa Cole
Head, Startup Programs | Redwood Inference
